sn48.50:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Aṅgesu viharati Āpanaṃ nāma Aṅgānaṃ nigamo || || 2.
sn48.50:1.3: Tatra kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Sāriputtam āmantesi || ||
sn48.50:1.4: Yo so Sāriputta ariyasāvako Tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno || api nu so Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā khaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā ti || || 3.
sn48.50:2.1: Yoso bhante ariyasāvako Tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno || na so Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā || ||
sn48.50:2.2: Saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa etam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ || yam āraddhaviriyo viharissati akusalānaṃ dhammānam pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānam upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu || || 4.
sn48.50:2.3: Yaṃ hissa bhante viriyaṃ tad assa viriyindriyam || ||
sn48.50:3.1: Saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa etam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ || yaṃ satimā bhavissati paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatam pi cirabhāsitam pi saritā anussaritā || || 5.
sn48.50:3.2: Yā hissa bhante sati tad assa satindriyaṃ || ||
sn48.50:4.1: Saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa upaṭṭhitasatino etam pātikaṅkhaṃ || yaṃ vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhim labhissati cittassa ekaggataṃ || || 6.
sn48.50:4.2: Yo hissa bhante samādhi tad assa samādhindriyaṃ || ||
sn48.50:5.1: Saddhassa hi bhante ariyasāvakassa upaṭṭhitasatino samāhitacittassa etam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ || yam evam pajānissati
sn48.50:5.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati || avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvatam saṃsarataṃ
sn48.50:5.4: avijjāya tveva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho santam etam padam phanitam etam padam yad idaṃ
sn48.50:5.5: sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbupadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ || || 7.
sn48.50:5.6: Yā hissa bhante paññā tad assa paññindriyaṃ ||
sn48.50:6.1: Saddho so bhante ariyasāvako evam padahitvā padahitvā evaṃ saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evam pajānitvā pajānitvā evam abhisaddahati ||
sn48.50:6.2: Ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ ||
sn48.50:6.3: te dānāham etarahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi || paññāyaca ativijjha passāmīti || || 8.
sn48.50:6.4: Yā hissa bhante saddhā tad assa saddhindriyan ti || || 9.
sn48.50:7.2: Yo so Sāriputta ariyasāvako Tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno na so Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā || ||
sn48.50:7.3: Saddhassa hi Sāriputta ariyasāvakassa etam pātikaṅkhaṃ || yaṃ āraddhaviriyo viharissati
sn48.50:7.4: akusalānaṃ dhammānam pahānāya kusalānam dhammānam upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu || || 10--13.
sn48.50:7.5: Yaṃ hissa Sāriputta viriyam tad assa viriyindriyaṃ || ||
sn48.50:11.1: Saddho so Sāriputta ariyasāvako evam padahitvā padahitvā evam saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evam pajānitvā pajānitvā evam abhisaddahati || ||
sn48.50:11.2: Ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ ||
sn48.50:11.3: te dānāham etarahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī ti || || 14.
sn48.50:11.4: Yā hissa Sāriputta saddhā tad assa saddhindriyanti || ||
